title: Hybrid Identity Synchronization Health

controlTest.positiveScenario: Inject sample events matching UC-4.4.28 SPL; confirm the search returns rows and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign traffic without matching markers; confirm UC-4.4.28 search returns zero rows.

dataSources: `index=azure` sourcetype=`mscs:azure:audit` collected via `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`, Windows/Entra diagnostics, GCP Identity logs; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.
spl:
index=azure sourcetype="mscs:azure:audit" (  (operationName.value="*AADConnect*" OR activityDisplayName="*sync*") activityStatus!="Success")

| sort -_time
description: AD Connect, Cloud Identity, and similar sync failures leave cloud groups stale, breaking access and compliance.
value: Detecting hybrid identity synchronization health early reduces mean time to contain cloud incidents, supports audit logging controls, and prevents silent misconfiguration drift across accounts.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=azure`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`, Windows/Entra diagnostics, GCP Identity logs with the modular input for `mscs:azure:audit`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.4.33.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Ingest connector health JSON or Event Hub stream. Correlate with password hash sync errors and object export failures. Alert on any failed sync window or rising error count.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="mscs:azure:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="mscs:azure:audit" (  (operationName.value="*AADConnect*" OR activityDisplayName="*sync*") activityStatus!="Success")
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.4.28_hybrid_identity_synchron_28"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `mscs:azure:audit` in `index=azure` to detect hybrid identity synchronization health. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_4_28_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Timeline (sync status), Table (connector, error), Single value (last successful sync age in minutes)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`, Windows/Entra diagnostics, GCP Identity logs and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of hybrid identity synchronization health so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
